proof_summary: Positivity follows by explicitly constructing a partition according to \(n\bmod 4\): use \(\{n\}\), \(\{9,n-9\}\), \(\{18,n-18\}\), or \(\{27,n-27\}\) in residue classes \(0,1,2,3\), with the special case \(n=27\) handled by \(\{27\}\). The fixed parts are divisible by \(9\), while each complementary part is divisible by \(4\), so all parts are nonsquarefree; the bound \(n>23\) ensures they are positive and distinct.
